lineage.strategy: Shift from quantum project milestones to current company-wide operating and cash-flow evidence that Alpha can use for factor/risk/confidence construction.

observations.fact: IBM reported Q2 2026 revenue of $17.2 billion, up 1% year over year, and narrowed full-year constant-currency revenue growth expectations to 4%-5%.
IBM generated $4.8 billion of free cash flow in the first half, flat year over year, while maintaining its expectation for full-year free cash flow to increase about $1 billion year over year.

IBM disclosed nearly $500 million of order backlog in Power and Storage after record-paced growth in distributed infrastructure, while cash ended Q2 at $8.2 billion after $10.5 billion of acquisitions year to date and total debt was $62.0 billion.

risks.risk: Q2 revenue growth was only 1% year over year and management cited late-quarter revenue headwinds; acquisitions reduced cash materially while debt remained substantial.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not isolate realized revenue, margin or cash returns from IBM's quantum initiatives; those economics remain separate from consolidated operating evidence.

recommendation: Use the consolidated revenue, cash-flow, backlog, acquisition and leverage data as source-addressed underwriting inputs; keep quantum economics separately unknown.
